svg.title: The press: your own place in the line, on a phone
svg.text: the Clash · your company is in the water
Your eye: their second man is blown and his shield
hangs low. The bank is slick. Bastian cannot hold long.

g.text: the First Form: hold, and cover him
Turn the Point, and step in
the Second Form: inside the tired man’s spear
no form of yours answers this

svg.text: Your art wants a strong arm, and yours is: it sits well on you.
The Rim Blow and The Wall Walks are not yet yours.
